name: Goblin camp lean-to
description: A crude lean-to about 2 × 2 m and 1.5 m high, open at the front: crooked branch rafters lean from a ridge pole on two forked posts to the ground, covered with ragged overlapping hides, more spread on the ground behind under stones,, over a bed of trodden straw with a matted fur, gnawed bones, a horned skull on a stick and a flint-tipped spear.

provenance.prompt: A crude lean-to of branches and hides over a bed of straw, about 2 × 2 × 1.5 m.
